question: In which movable, immovable, or material forms may a liṅga be established?
premises: A liṅga may be movable or immovable
A liṅga may be made of metal
A liṅga may be gem-born or a bāṇa-liṅga
inference: Liṅgas are permitted in various states and materials including movable, immovable, metal, gem-born, and bāṇa forms.
plain_english: A liṅga may be movable or immovable, and it may be made of metal, born of gems, or be a bāṇa-liṅga.
